description: Place a raster or SVG image on the board at (x, y) with explicit width/height in board pixels. Omit `id` for a new image. Reusing the ID of an existing image replaces its data, dimensions, and position. `data_url` MUST be a `data:image/(png|jpeg|gif|webp|svg+xml);base64,...` string ≤ ~900 kB; hosted URLs are not accepted. The bytes are header-checked (the leading bytes must be PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/SVG; not a full decode); SVG content must be declared `image/svg+xml`, raster content must not be. Strongly recommended: also pass a tiny `thumb_data_url` (≤8 kB JPEG/PNG/WebP, ~64 px on the long edge) — it is embedded into the SVG preview so OTHER AI viewers (and you, on later `get_preview` calls) can actually see the image instead of a placeholder box.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

id.description: Optional stable image ID; reusing an existing image ID replaces it.
